what_it_does: Tomahawk5 is a network switch chip designed to handle the explosive data volumes flowing between AI servers in data centers. Previous-generation switches could handle 25.6 trillion bits per second; this one doubles that to 51.2 trillion bits per second, all on a single silicon die made at the 5nm process. The challenge is connecting to different types of cables and optical connections while packing twice the switching power into the same technology. The chip uses advanced high-speed serial links (called SerDes) that can work with direct copper cables, fiber optics, and other connection types.
